GroupedInventory.note: Three groups with header glyph, label and count, and rows carrying the source glyph, source/target metadata cells, title + subtitle and the relative updated label.

CollapsibleGroups.note: onGroupToggle turns the headers into real buttons with rotating chevrons; the Unclaimed group is photographed collapsed.

Loading.note: Skeleton branch — five shimmer blocks in the two documented clusters.

NoWorkspaces.note: EmptyState branch with authored title and description.

LoadFailed.note: error={true} renders the 'Could not load workspaces' alert EmptyState.
